changelog: 2.6.5: New Dedicated 'Download by Language' Feature with Multi-Language Audio Track Selection
Dedicated Sidebar page for downloading videos in specific languages (Hindi, Urdu, English, Spanish, Arabic, etc.)
1-Click 'Inspect Audio Tracks' tool to auto-probe, detect, and list all available audio dubs on YouTube & Facebook videos
Lossless stream-copy FFmpeg muxing preserving 100% original uncompressed video resolution and studio-quality sound
High-speed HTTPS video & audio stream prioritization preventing HLS/m3u8 connection stalls
Multi-Track MKV support: Option to bundle all available languages into a single video file
Reverted standard download dialog to keep normal downloads fast and clutter-free
